text:
Six months out — how exciting! This is the perfect time to lock in the key details for your wedding.

Right now, your focus should be on finalizing the big-ticket items: your venue, photographer, caterer, and any other vendors you need (like a florist or band/DJ). If you’ve already booked these, it’s time to choose attire for both of you, send save-the-dates, and start planning décor and themes. It’s also a good idea to start thinking about your guest list and any travel arrangements for out-of-town guests.

Would you like help prioritizing these tasks or working on a specific part of your planning?
